title: Dances With Wolves
description: Costner's epic vision of the American frontier as seen through the eyes of a 19th-century U.S. Cavalry officer.

title: Bull Durham
description: A literary baseball groupie (Susan Sarandon) romances a pitcher (Tim Robbins) and a catcher (Kevin Costner) on a minor-league North Carolina team.

title: Rain Man
description: A wheeler-dealer (Tom Cruise) meets his brother (Dustin Hoffman), an institutionalized autistic-savant, heir to $3 million.
